_readme: DigitalCLIQ Inventory Pulse client roster. Hardcoded per Drew, 2026-08-06. Model years are NEVER stored here: the skill resolves current + incoming model year dynamically from live inventory each run. Update platform/notes fields as runs discover them (they are a cache, not a contract). fetch field per dealer: 'server' (urllib works) or 'browser' (WAF'd, needs the in-page JS strategy); probed 2026-08-15. 2026-10-20: Claude Browser pane crashes on heavy Dealer Inspire pages (Sterling, Crevier); other 9 browser dealers ran clean on tier 1.

schedule.note: Runs on the 5th (anchor: month-over-month vs prior month's anchor) and the 20th (pulse: vs this month's anchor).

client_dealer.name: Sterling BMW
client_dealer.notes: Server-fetch 403s; use the Dealer Inspire crawl strategy from compliance-audit memory (browser surfaces cascade). 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: Claude Browser pane (tier1) DEAD all session (navigate failed even on google.com) -> whole run ran on the Chrome extension tier2. Extension exposes 2 browsers and cannot disambiguate unattended: used 'Browser 1' deviceId 4d5c9bfc-44a9-4892-94d3-4dc119f18022. Site labels NEW-vehicle lease offers 'Pre-Owned' in its template (record as published). /finance-specials/ redirects to /lease-finance-offers/ and rendered empty: finance NOT verified. Only dealer with stored VDP urls, so the only one whose delistings are measurable. | 2026-09-20: 13 of 40 re-checked vehicle pages now soft-redirect (HTTP 200) to /used-vehicles/ = confirmed delisted. Lease page would not scroll past the first banner and the Offer Details lightbox never opened, so banners below the fold (X3/3 Series) were missed. X5 lease still served live but its published end date (August 31) has already passed. Real OC Lease Specials URL cached by the agent | 2026-10-05: Claude Browser tier1 worked all run. 13 of 40 rechecks soft-redirect to /used-vehicles/ (delisted). Lease pages /bmw-lease-specials-orange-county/, /bmw-lease-offers/, courtesy page read 'We Are Currently Updating Our Specials'. Advertised price = MSRP +$1,044 on most units, +$2,044 on X5 M models (unlabelled on site). | 2026-10-20: Claude Browser pane crashed ('Target crashed') on sitemap, SRP and lease pages across 6 tabs; same-origin fetch from /robots.txt still worked for the 40 recheck VDPs (13 soft-redirect to /used-vehicles/ = delisted); NO fresh new-vehicle sample. Lease pages still 'updating specials'; /lease-finance-offers/ -> /lease-and-finance-offers/ (contact form only); /bmw-finance-specials/ 404. Advertised = MSRP +$1,044 (+$2,044 X5 M Competition).

competitors.name: Crevier BMW
competitors.notes: Penske store. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: lease offers are TEXT-rendered homepage banner carousel (not images), disclaimers capturable verbatim. /finance/ read directly, no APR offers = verified_zero for finance. Sitemap sampling: use hyphen-suffixed match tokens (x3-, x5-) to avoid VIN-substring false positives. | 2026-09-20: in-page fetch of /sitemap.xml now returns 403 (WAF tightened since 2026-09-06); the jsfetch bypass is dead here. browser-srp via SNIPPET C worked. Working SRP search/sort param discovered: ?q={term} | 2026-10-05: SRP /new-vehicles/?q={term} price-sorted ascending, wait 3-4s. Lease banners (image) at /new-bmw-lease-finance-apr-offers-santa-ana-ca/; Offer Details modal not reachable via DOM. 0.9% APR banners on homepage. | 2026-10-20: pane crashed on heavy pages, Chrome extension tier2 used. SRP /new-vehicles/?q=x5|x3|330i|m340i price asc (q='3 series' returns unfiltered list); card shows 2 prices $122 apart, first used. 3 lease banners read from pixels (330i $459, X3 30 $549, X5 sDrive40i $839; 39 mo; exp 11/02/2026); Offer Details modal unreachable so disclaimers not captured; 0.9% APR homepage banners not re-read (finance needs_human_review).

competitors.name: Irvine BMW
competitors.notes: Shelly Auto Group. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /promotions/new/bmw-promotions.htm rendered EMPTY body twice -> offers unverified, never claim verified_zero. Sitemap mixes static model-landing pages (/new-bmw/330i-irvine-ca.htm) + blog posts that match substring filters: require a VIN in the path (6 of 18 dropped). | 2026-09-20: /promotions/new/bmw-promotions.htm rendered EMPTY for the THIRD run running; homepage banners are vague CTAs with no figures and /finance.htm soft-redirects to generic inventory. Offers remain needs_human_review, never verified_zero. VDP urls use an opaque hash, not the VIN: /new/BMW/{yr}-BMW-{model}-{hash}.htm, so VIN-in-path filtering does not work here | 2026-10-05: promotions page EMPTY for the 4th run running. SRP /new-inventory/index.htm?search={term}, lazy cards (scroll 2x10 ticks), VIN only via in-page VDP fetch. | 2026-10-20: promotions page EMPTY for the 5th run. SRP /new-inventory/index.htm?search={term} lazy cards; VIN is in the card HTML (no VDP fetch needed); card shows MSRP then total (+$122). M340i search 0 cards. Platform is Dealer.com-family (unconfirmed), not 'Shelly Auto Group' (that is the owner group).

competitors.name: Long Beach BMW
competitors.notes: Domain verified live 2026-08-06. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /promotions/new/index.htm renders offer cards as text-on-image banners; headline pmt/term/DAS readable via get_page_text, full disclaimers often NOT reachable (flag disclaimer_not_captured). Sitemap noise: model-landing pages + blogs, require VIN in path (6 of 17 dropped). | 2026-09-20: platform CONFIRMED Dealer.com-family (same as Irvine BMW), not Dealer Inspire. Full verbatim lease disclaimers WERE reachable this run, improving on the prior 'disclaimers often not reachable' note. Finance needs manual review: homepage banner advertises 0.9%/60mo but the detail page was not locatable in the time box | 2026-10-05: /promotions/new/index.htm fully TEXT-rendered (innerText gives verbatim disclaimers; disclaimer gives only $0.25/mile over allowance, no allowance figure). SRP /new-inventory/index.htm?search= redirects to /new-bmw/long-beach.htm?search=. | 2026-10-20: 3 lease offers verbatim via innerText (X3 30 $549/39/$5,279; X5 sDrive40i $839/39/$6,819; 330i $459/39/$4,939; all conditional Loyalty Credit; 10k mi/yr, $0.25/mi over). SRP /new-bmw/long-beach.htm?search={term}, card MSRP then total (+$170). M340i 0 cards. 0.9%/60 banner detail still not located (finance needs_human_review).

client_dealer.name: McPeek's CDJR of Anaheim
client_dealer.notes: Server-fetchable with Chrome UA. Inventory sitemap https://www.mcpeeks.com/inventory-sitemap.xml, VDP /inventory/display/{cond}/{year}/{make}/{model}/{VIN}. JSON-LD Vehicle on VDPs. Prices arrive as $ entities: html.unescape first. Politeness: max 3 workers, 0.7s pacing (site went down under a 10-worker crawl on 2026-07-26). home+sitemaps 200 (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /specials is an EMPTY STUB and /lease-specials + /specials/{jeep,ram}.htm all redirect to the homepage - this platform has NO dedicated brand/lease specials pages. Real offers live in hidden .slide-disclaimer DOM on the homepage carousel and are PURCHASE DISCOUNTS, not leases (no monthly payment). Server fetch still fine for inventory. | 2026-10-05: hidden .slide-disclaimer DOM in SERVER HTML holds stock-numbered single-unit LEASE offers (1500 Big Horn Stk T0139, Wrangler Willys Stk T0100), extract with a python parser; correction to the 'purchase discounts only' note. | 2026-10-20: server mode fine (24 urls, 0 failures). 3 single-unit stock-numbered leases in hidden .slide-disclaimer (Grand Cherokee DTS1373 $369, Wrangler Willys T0100 $389, 1500 Big Horn T0139 $399; all $4,369 DAS). 7 Ram 1500 VINs parse an implausible ~$388,600 MSRP (zeroed by merge). /lease-specials redirects home.

competitors.name: Orange Coast CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: /inventory-sitemap.xml clean per-model; specials are TEXT (not banners) at /new-vehicles/new-specials/; /finance-specials 404s. | 2026-09-06: /inventory-sitemap.xml clean per-model; specials are TEXT at /new-vehicles/new-specials/; /finance-specials 404s. browser-jsfetch ok. | 2026-09-20: sitemap + specials both clean again; /finance-specials still 404s (not re-probed) | 2026-10-05: Dealer Inspire. /new-vehicles/new-specials/ read 'currently updating our monthly offers' (no cards). browser-jsfetch sitemap worked. | 2026-10-20: sitemap.xml AND inventory-sitemap.xml now 403 even to in-page fetch (Cloudflare): go straight to per-model SRPs /new-vehicles/{ram-1500,wrangler,pacifica,charger}/ and parse DOM text (split on 'NEW 20yy'); Cloudflare challenge clears in ~6s. Price = card Sale Price (includes $122 fees, before bonus cash). Specials page still 'currently updating our monthly offers' (verified_zero). Claude Browser worked.

competitors.name: Huntington Beach CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: bare '1500' match false-positives on ProMaster 1500 (exclude promaster|fleet-new URLs); specials are banner images at /specials/(brand).htm; floating 'Bad Credit?' CTA masks part of each banner's fine print (note in parse_note). | 2026-09-06: MUST exclude promaster|fleet-new URLs from a bare '1500' match (135 skipped this run). Specials are banner images at /specials/(brand).htm. The 'Bad Credit?' floating CTA was NOT present this run. | 2026-09-20: promaster|fleet-new exclusion held with zero false positives. One sitemap hit was an SRP category page, not a vehicle page: drop non-VIN urls. Pacifica specials page loaded with zero banners = verified_zero | 2026-10-05: Dealer.com. /specials/{jeep,ram,dodge,chrysler}.htm and /specials/new.htm 200 with no banners; /new-vehicle-specials.htm 404. Sitemap VDP urls carry a hash, VIN from JSON-LD. Exclude Promaster/fleet. | 2026-10-20: /sitemap.xml via in-page fetch works (509 VDP urls, hashed slugs, JSON-LD VIN+price). Banners at /specials/jeep.htm (4) and /specials/ram.htm (2): Ram 1500 Big Horn & Laramie 0% APR/60 mo, $2,500 down, exp 11/02/26; Ram 12% below MSRP rebate (excl RHO); Dodge and Chrysler pages carry no banners (lease not verified_zero).

competitors.name: Puente Hills CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: bare '1500' can hit VIN digit coincidences (verify model); real specials page /best-jeep-dodge-chrysler-ram-lease-offers-serving-los-angeles-ca/ (text cards). | 2026-09-06: specials pages (combined + per-brand) use a scroll-lock/lazy-render pattern that blocks reading offers - only 1 of ~4 captured, mark needs_human_review, do NOT claim verified_zero. Use word-boundary '1500' matching to avoid VIN-digit false positives. Site shows an identical $58,085 MSRP across 3 different Pacifica trims (shared-widget artifact, keep as-extracted). | 2026-09-20: NO lazy-render block this run, specials pages loaded fine, but they render as a paginated per-VIN rebate-stack grid rather than $/mo lease banners, so offers stay needs_human_review. MSRP on vehicle pages is unreliable: one Wrangler VIN scraped $53,120 on its page vs $44,990 for the same VIN on the dealer's own specials grid. Pacifica $58,085 duplicate-MSRP artifact reproduced | 2026-10-05: Dealer Inspire. Specials page /best-jeep-dodge-chrysler-ram-lease-offers-serving-los-angeles-ca/ is a paginated per-VIN rebate grid (no payments). VDP MSRPs unreliable vs that grid; many VDPs lack JSON-LD. | 2026-10-20: sitemaps 403 to in-page fetch; per-model SRP DOM /new-vehicles/{model}/ worked (16 rows, no VDP urls). Price = SRP Total Price (incl $122 fees, before bonus cash). Specials page still a per-VIN rebate grid with no payments or APR (needs_human_review). The $58,085 Pacifica MSRP artifact did NOT reproduce this run.

client_dealer.name: Nissan of Irvine
client_dealer.notes: home 200, sitemap.xml 200, no inventory-sitemap (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-04: sitemap.xml WAF-blocked this run; fell back to recheck VDPs (existing VINs only). Consider browser mode for full NEW-inventory discovery next run. | 2026-09-06: sitemap.xml WAF-blocked again; server mode reaches recheck VDPs only. Full NEW-inventory discovery needs the browser: SRP /inventory/?model=X&dealername=nissan of irvine, price-ascending. Specials are JS-rendered, unreadable server-side. Watch banner-vs-disclaimer DAS mismatches ($2,995 headline vs $4,995/$5,495 fine print, 2 seen this run) - always record the disclosure figure. Consider flipping fetch to 'browser'. | 2026-09-20: FLIPPED fetch server -> browser. sitemap.xml WAF-blocked for the THIRD run running, so server mode reaches only re-check vehicle pages and discovers no new inventory. Specials are JS-rendered and unreadable server-side. Use the live SRP /inventory/?model=X&dealername=nissan of irvine, price-ascending | 2026-10-05: HomeNet-style SRP /inventory/new-nissan-{model}/ default price-ascending, cards expose data-vin + data-sales-price; ?page= does not paginate. Rechecks soft-redirect to model listing when gone (23 of 40 this run). Banner DAS ($2,995) disagrees with disclosure ($4,995/$5,495) on Sentra/Rogue. | 2026-10-20: Claude Browser ok. SRP cards are .carbox-wrap with data-vin + data-sales-price and are NOT price-sorted: take the 4 lowest of the first 25 per model. Specials at /specials/ (/new-vehicle-specials/ is 404). 21 of 40 rechecks soft-redirect to the model listing (delisted). Banner-vs-disclosure DAS mismatch on Altima ($2,495 vs $1,999), Sentra ($2,995 vs $4,995), Kicks ($2,995 vs $4,995), Rogue ($2,995 vs $5,495); Pathfinder card expired 10/2/2026 still posted. AGENT BUG this run: vdp_url written with a doubled origin (https://x.comhttps://x.com/...); merge_extract now normalizes it.

competitors.name: Nissan of Costa Mesa
competitors.notes: WAF newly enabled 2026-09-04: server fetch now 403s (was server-fetchable 2026-08-15). Real inventory sitemap is /inventoryvdpsitemap.xml (found via /sitemap.xml index); the old /inventory-sitemap.xml intermittently returns a cookie-shell HTML. Browser-jsfetch works. | 2026-09-06: /inventoryvdpsitemap.xml is STALE (357 of 358 urls 'Sentra') - do NOT trust it, use the live SRP instead. SRP shows MSRP only, real discount is gated behind a lead form, so its prices are not comparable to rivals' discounted advertised prices - caveat any price ranking. Specials page = Kicks cash-offer cards only. | 2026-10-20: 12 of 13 rechecks live (1 gone). Specials /new-vehicle-specials/ = 3 banner images with no DOM disclaimer text, fine print unreadable at 600px (needs_human_review): Kicks SV lease ~$279/36/$2,909; finance Rogue 0%/60 + $1,000 NMAC loyalty, Pathfinder 0%/60, Sentra 4.9%/60 (approx). Price = Sale Price (after Nissan cash). Live rechecks outside the 4 lowest per model carry price 0.
